name: Tabetha's Task
summary: Tabetha, a mage in Dustwallow Marsh, may know more about a rumor involving a sand troll in Zul'Farrak. You are asked to speak with her at her cottage.

sections.title: A Mage in the Marsh
sections.body: A rumor brings you to Tabetha, a mage who lives in Dustwallow Marsh. She may tell you more about her quarrel with a sand troll in Zul'Farrak. Her cottage lies west of Theramore and north of the Stonemaul Ruin, and you are urged to bring friends in case she sends you onward.

faq.answer: Tabetha is a mage who lives in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Why am I looking for Tabetha?
faq.answer: A rumor says Tabetha has a quarrel with a sand troll in Zul'Farrak, and she may tell you more.
Tabetha's cottage is west of Theramore and north of the Stonemaul Ruin.
You are advised to bring friends in case Tabetha sends you to Zul'Farrak.
